T: The Dude abides. So does the White Russian.
D: A laid-back bowler gets mixed up in a kidnapping case.
P: Serve a White Russian every time the Dude makes one.
S: League night chilli con queso nachos
league night with Walter and Donny

Corn chips under a hot chilli con queso of cheddar, tomato and green chilli, with pickled jalapeños, sour cream and coriander, served in cardboard trays. Cook 1 diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 1 diced green chilli, 1 tsp cumin and 1 diced tomato and cook 3 minutes. Add 375ml evaporated milk and bring to a simmer, then stir in 200g grated cheddar off the heat until smooth. Divide 250g corn chips between 4 cardboard trays, pour over the queso and top with 40g pickled jalapeños, sour cream and coriander. Serve straight away.
it really tied the room together

Crisp lavash rectangles striped with smoked paprika, cumin and sesame like the Dude's rug, served with a whipped feta and lemon dip. Cut 2 lavash sheets into 12 rectangles and brush with 1 tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle half a tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp ground cumin and 10g sesame seeds in alternating stripes. Bake at 180C for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp, then cool. Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp olive oil until smooth for dipping.
the Dude buys half-and-half in his dressing gown

Ricotta and cream cheese whipped silky with a splash of cream, swirled with hot honey and cracked pepper, with warm grilled sourdough fingers. Beat 300g ricotta, 100g cream cheese and 2 tbsp cream until very smooth, about 2 minutes, with a pinch of salt and lemon zest. Warm 3 tbsp honey with half a tsp chilli flakes. Slice half a sourdough loaf into fingers, brush with olive oil and grill or toast 2 minutes a side. Spread the ricotta in a shallow bowl, drizzle with the hot honey and finish with plenty of cracked black pepper.
M: Walter, Donny and the Dude between frames
Two thin patties smashed on a hot griddle, American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce, double-fried chips.
snacks at the lanes between frames

Griddled beef franks in toasted buns smothered with beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, raw onion and mustard, eaten in a booth by the lanes. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g tinned tomatoes and 400g drained kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Simmer 8 beef franks for 5 minutes, then sear on a griddle until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli, 100g grated cheddar between them, diced raw onion and mustard.
W: Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwiches
the Dude's White Russian, turned into dessert

Brown butter choc chip cookies sandwiched with vanilla ice cream rippled with coffee liqueur, edges rolled in crushed chocolate-coated coffee beans. Brown 150g butter, cool, then beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg. Mix in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb soda and 150g choc chips and chill overnight. Bake 16 small balls at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream, ripple through 60ml coffee liqueur and refreeze 1 hour. Sandwich scoops between cookies, roll the edges in 50g crushed chocolate-coated coffee beans and freeze 30 minutes.
K: 45ml vodka and 20ml coffee liqueur over ice in a rocks glass, topped with 30ml cream (or half and half), stirred lazily.

m.note: Double smashed beef patties with cheese, onion, pickles and crisp chips.
m.how: Cut 600g potatoes into chips, rinse and dry thoroughly. Blanch in neutral oil at 140°C for 5 minutes, drain and cool 15 minutes, then fry again at 185°C for 3 minutes until crisp. Season with salt. Divide 700g beef mince into 8 loose balls. Smash thin on a hot griddle, season and cook 2 minutes per side until cooked through. Melt 120g American-style cheese over the patties. Toast 4 burger buns. Mix 60g mayonnaise, 20g tomato sauce and 10g mustard for burger sauce. Fill each bun with two patties, 1 thinly sliced onion, 80g dill pickles and sauce. Serve chips alongside.

d.note: Vodka and coffee liqueur over ice, topped with thick cream.
d.how: Divide 400g ice among four rocks glasses. Add 45ml vodka and 20ml coffee liqueur to each. Top each with 30ml thickened cream and stir lazily. Totals are 180ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 120ml cream. Serve one prepared drink per person.
